transcript.statement: Safety is paramount in a bookkeeping system to ensure accurate financial records and prevent data loss. Requirements SAF-01 and SAF-02 ensure data integrity and adherence to double-entry principles, while SAF-03 mandates a robust audit trail for accountability. SAF-04 and SAF-05 focus on fault tolerance and safe degradation, allowing users to access essential functionalities during outages. SAF-06 and SAF-07 emphasize the importance of validating currency conversions and regular backups to prevent discrepancies and data loss.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure accurate recording of financial transactions to prevent data loss and corruption.
The system shall implement double-entry bookkeeping principles to ensure integrity and prevent discrepancies.
The system shall maintain a comprehensive audit trail of all transactions for accountability.
The system shall provide error handling mechanisms to manage and recover from faults during transaction processing.
The system shall support safe degradation, ensuring access to essential functionalities during outages.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent financial discrepancies.
The system shall perform regular backups of financial data to prevent loss in case of system failure.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are processed within 2 seconds to optimize responsiveness.
The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users to ensure adequate throughput.
The system shall utilize efficient data structures to minimize memory usage by 30%.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall implement caching for frequently accessed data to reduce latency by at least 50%.
The system shall ensure that currency conversion operations complete within 3 seconds for real-time transactions.
The system shall maintain an audit trail that logs each transaction with a maximum logging delay of 1 second.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing by using efficient algorithms.
The system shall implement cloud-based solutions to reduce the carbon footprint associated with local server maintenance.
The system shall support document digitization to reduce paper usage by at least 80%.
The system shall track the lifecycle resource impact of accounting features to identify areas for improvement.
The system shall provide users with sustainability reports showing energy and resource consumption metrics.
The system shall ensure compliance with sustainability regulations and standards relevant to financial systems.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict user permissions based on their roles.
The system shall validate data input to prevent unauthorized or malicious data entry.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for all users accessing financial data.
The system shall log all user access and modifications to data, retaining logs for review.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards to guarantee legal accountability.
The system shall implement user access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can modify transactions.
The system shall log all financial transactions with timestamps and user identifiers to maintain a transparent audit trail.
The system shall support reporting that complies with local and international accounting standards to ensure fairness in financial reporting.
The system shall include mechanisms for users to report ethical concerns or violations confidentially.
The system shall provide multi-currency support with transparent exchange rates to ensure fairness in international transactions.
